items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Because he used to pass by and stop and talk with us every night when he was going to work

ctx.x: Well that's, I copied that from Happi because Happi used to do that really. Happi used to do that all the time, you know. And, well he wanted to go to a dance. He even went and rented the snare drum so he could get in the dance without paying, you know, because he was charging admission at the door. Well he carried the snare drum along with him and this letter went right on. He just went up on the bandstand and get up there and set the drum up a while, you know, rest him up and, well I started doing the same…
Well I can ask more about Joe Lynch's.
